a.lede: The truth is, there's no surprising meaning for the "A" in USB-A. Discover what this connector is used for and if it's becoming obsolete.
a.title: What's the meaning of the "A" on your USB-A ports?

b.lede: Some USB connectors, including USB-A, feature two small holes that have an important purpose. Other USB connectors lack these holes for a reason, too.
b.title: Why do some USB connectors have those 2 square holes?
